Despite booking via 111 due to worsening pelvic pain and bleeding, the doctor’s conduct was deeply unprofessional:
Lack of Preparedness: Although an interpreter was requested in advance, she was completely unaware of the request and wasted time asking other staff how to access the service.
Intimidating and Dishonest Attitude: Throughout the brief 11-minute consultation (ended at 1:51 AM), she repeatedly pressured both me and the interpreter to "hurry up" because of "waiting patients." However, when I left, the waiting area was completely empty. This was a blatant lie to rush a patient in pain.
Negligent Consultation: The consultation was superficial—only checking my temperature and blood pressure—which I could have done at home. She failed to provide a meaningful diagnosis for my severe symptoms.
Pharmacy Error: Without my consent, she arbitrarily changed my nominated pharmacy, forcing me to travel further despite my illness.
